data.title: Nad Al Sheba Gardens Phase 11
data.about:
Nad Al Sheba Gardens by Meraas is a thoughtfully master-planned community located in Nad Al Sheba, one of Dubai’s most serene and well-connected neighborhoods. 

With the highly anticipated Phase 11 now launched, this gated enclave introduces elegant 3-bedroom townhouses and expansive 4 and 5-bedroom villas. This latest release builds on the success of its previous sell-out phases, offering new opportunities in a lush, low-density environment with distinctive architecture and open green spaces.

Crafted by renowned developer Meraas, this project blends urban sophistication with community charm. Nad Al Sheba Gardens Phase 11 features premium amenities like a swimmable beach pool, landscaped community parks, and a clubhouse, all tailored to elevate the family lifestyle. 

Backed by a proven high ROI and the credibility of a top-tier developer, the project stands out for its strategic location, curated lifestyle, and exceptional long-term value.

characteristics_module.title: Nad Al Sheba Gardens by Meraas – Designed for Life, Crafted for Legacy
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Location Advantage – Centrally located in Nad Al Sheba, with easy access to Downtown Dubai, Meydan, and major highways.
  • Reputable Developer – Developed by Meraas, known for premium, design-focused communities in Dubai.
  • Gated Community – Private and secure environment with lush landscaping and low population density.
  • Premium Amenities – Enjoy a swimmable lagoon pool, clubhouse, community parks, and more for all age groups.
  • Attractive Pricing – Phase 11 introduces accessible luxury with compelling pricing for townhouses and villas.
  • Strong Investment Value – High projected ROI supported by community growth and developer track record.
  • Flexible Payment Plan – Investor-friendly 80/20 plan with staggered instalments and convenient handover terms.
  • Architectural Elegance – Unique designs with bronze screens, double-height spaces, and seamless indoor-outdoor living.

location_tile.title: Prime Connectivity in Nad Al Sheba
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Nad Al Sheba Gardens is ideally located within Nad Al Sheba, offering unmatched access to Dubai’s major destinations. The community lies close to Dubai – Al Ain Road (E66) and Al Khail Road (E44), connecting residents to vibrant urban hubs with ease. The Nad Al Sheba Gardens location balances serenity with connectivity, making it perfect for families and investors alike.

  • 5 Minutes – Meydan Racetrack
  • 10 Minutes – Downtown Dubai
  • 10 Minutes – Dubai Hills Mall
  • 15 Minutes – Dubai International Airport
